body.title: Recovery in Washington. All 39 Counties.
paragraphs: King, Pierce, Snohomish, and Spokane counties generate the highest volume of Washington foreclosure surplus cases. Washington is primarily a non-judicial foreclosure state using a deed of trust and trustee sale process. Trustee sale surplus funds are held by the trustee or deposited into the Washington Superior Court until claimed by the former owner. Washington tax foreclosure sales conducted by county treasurers also produce excess proceeds recoverable by the former owner.

The Washington Unclaimed Property Division, administered by the state Department of Revenue, holds over $1 billion in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to Washington residents. RCG searches Washington Superior Court records, county trustee sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every Washington client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Washington. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
